units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, Pantheon.

units.rawText: ...Dammit! If this continues, it'll only take a few minutes for all of the Sanctifiers on the field to come under their control!
units.displayText: ...Dammit! If this continues, it'll only take a few minutes for all of the Sanctifiers on the field to come under their control!

spans.text: ...Dammit! If this continues, it'll only take a few minutes for all of the Sanctifiers on the field to come under their control!

units.rawText: Antonina, how much of the Sacred Canon is under Eosphorus' control?
units.displayText: Antonina, how much of the Sacred Canon is under Eosphorus' control?

spans.text: Antonina, how much of the Sacred Canon is under Eosphorus' control?

units.rawText: More or less the same as the amount that's preserved here... About half of total.
units.displayText: More or less the same as the amount that's preserved here... About half of total.

spans.text: More or less the same as the amount that's preserved here... About half of total.

units.rawText: Can we trace the location of Eosphorus' half of the Canon from the data we have?
units.displayText: Can we trace the location of Eosphorus' half of the Canon from the data we have?

spans.text: Can we trace the location of Eosphorus' half of the Canon from the data we have?

units.rawText: I'm trying! But I think we're too late...
units.displayText: I'm trying! But I think we're too late...

spans.text: I'm trying! But I think we're too late...

units.rawText: The Entropization has already taken place. Even if we can find it, there's nothing we can do...
units.displayText: The Entropization has already taken place. Even if we can find it, there's nothing we can do...

spans.text: The Entropization has already taken place. Even if we can find it, there's nothing we can do...

units.rawText: Antonina slams her keyboard, the unwillingness and powerlessness in her heart getting to her.
units.displayText: Antonina slams her keyboard, the unwillingness and powerlessness in her heart getting to her.

spans.text: Antonina slams her keyboard, the unwillingness and powerlessness in her heart getting to her.

units.rawText: Damn it, we were playing into Eosphorus' hands all along!
units.displayText: Damn it, we were playing into Eosphorus' hands all along!

spans.text: Damn it, we were playing into Eosphorus' hands all along!

units.rawText: Antonina, you said you worked on cloud networking safety, right?
units.displayText: Antonina, you said you worked on cloud networking safety, right?

spans.text: Antonina, you said you worked on cloud networking safety, right?

units.rawText: ...Yeah, but that isn't related to the business at hand. We can talk about it later!
units.displayText: ...Yeah, but that isn't related to the business at hand. We can talk about it later!

spans.text: ...Yeah, but that isn't related to the business at hand. We can talk about it later!

units.rawText: No, it's very much related.
units.displayText: No, it's very much related.

spans.text: No, it's very much related.

units.rawText: The Professor continues.
units.displayText: The Professor continues.

spans.text: The Professor continues.

units.rawText: The networking safety project you worked on—the <color=orange>Sanctifier project</color> is our only hope.
units.displayText: The networking safety project you worked on—the Sanctifier project is our only hope.

spans.text: The networking safety project you worked on—the
Sanctifier project
is our only hope.

units.rawText: Sanctifier... project?
units.displayText: Sanctifier... project?

spans.text: Sanctifier... project?

units.rawText: Yes. Quick, Antonina, have a look at the Canon's composition!
units.displayText: Yes. Quick, Antonina, have a look at the Canon's composition!

spans.text: Yes. Quick, Antonina, have a look at the Canon's composition!

units.rawText: Understood!
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Antonina quickly returns to inspecting the Reverse Babylon Tower's data.
units.displayText: Antonina quickly returns to inspecting the Reverse Babylon Tower's data.

spans.text: Antonina quickly returns to inspecting the Reverse Babylon Tower's data.

units.rawText: Code scrolls rapidly on her terminal. The feeling of familiarity hits her once more and she becomes certain that everything here is her work.
units.displayText: Code scrolls rapidly on her terminal. The feeling of familiarity hits her once more and she becomes certain that everything here is her work.

spans.text: Code scrolls rapidly on her terminal. The feeling of familiarity hits her once more and she becomes certain that everything here is her work.

units.rawText: An ID most familiar to her appears on the screen and she can no longer hold in her surprise.
units.displayText: An ID most familiar to her appears on the screen and she can no longer hold in her surprise.

spans.text: An ID most familiar to her appears on the screen and she can no longer hold in her surprise.

units.rawText: All of these Sanctifiers' code... are iterations of mine?
units.displayText: All of these Sanctifiers' code... are iterations of mine?

spans.text: All of these Sanctifiers' code... are iterations of mine?

units.rawText: ...Exactly as I guessed.
units.displayText: ...Exactly as I guessed.

spans.text: ...Exactly as I guessed.

units.rawText: To ensure the network's absolute safety, of course you would hide some important keys on yourself.
units.displayText: To ensure the network's absolute safety, of course you would hide some important keys on yourself.

spans.text: To ensure the network's absolute safety, of course you would hide some important keys on yourself.

units.rawText: Why do you know all of this...
units.displayText: Why do you know all of this...

spans.text: Why do you know all of this...

units.rawText: An answer arises in the Doll's mind the moment she asks the question.
units.displayText: An answer arises in the Doll's mind the moment she asks the question.

spans.text: An answer arises in the Doll's mind the moment she asks the question.

units.rawText: Antonina instinctively takes a glance at Eucharist as the latter plays about with an arrow, not realizing Antonina's display just then.
units.displayText: Antonina instinctively takes a glance at Eucharist as the latter plays about with an arrow, not realizing Antonina's display just then.

spans.text: Antonina instinctively takes a glance at Eucharist as the latter plays about with an arrow, not realizing Antonina's display just then.

units.rawText: Hm? What is it, lil' Anna?
units.displayText: Hm? What is it, lil' Anna?

spans.text: Hm? What is it, lil' Anna?

units.rawText: Nothing.
units.displayText: Nothing.

spans.text: Nothing.

units.rawText: Is that so? Go do what you will and struggle before your defeat, then!
units.displayText: Is that so? Go do what you will and struggle before your defeat, then!

spans.text: Is that so? Go do what you will and struggle before your defeat, then!

units.rawText: When Big Sis wakes up, she will realize her mistakes and return to my side.
units.displayText: When Big Sis wakes up, she will realize her mistakes and return to my side.

spans.text: When Big Sis wakes up, she will realize her mistakes and return to my side.

units.rawText: Then, I will have her end you herself, so that you will both feel this torment, body and soul... A most delicious delight, no?
units.displayText: Then, I will have her end you herself, so that you will both feel this torment, body and soul... A most delicious delight, no?

spans.text: Then, I will have her end you herself, so that you will both feel this torment, body and soul... A most delicious delight, no?

units.rawText: ...Your personality really is off-putting.
units.displayText: ...Your personality really is off-putting.

spans.text: ...Your personality really is off-putting.

units.rawText: I could say the same.
units.displayText: I could say the same.

spans.text: I could say the same.

units.rawText: The emerald-haired Doll sighs once more, focusing on the code in front of her.
units.displayText: The emerald-haired Doll sighs once more, focusing on the code in front of her.

spans.text: The emerald-haired Doll sighs once more, focusing on the code in front of her.

units.rawText: Since you've found the key already, can you try connect to the Reverse Babylon Tower and grab the ownership of the rest of the Canon from Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Since you've found the key already, can you try connect to the Reverse Babylon Tower and grab the ownership of the rest of the Canon from Eosphorus?

spans.text: Since you've found the key already, can you try connect to the Reverse Babylon Tower and grab the ownership of the rest of the Canon from Eosphorus?

units.rawText: There's a chance... let me try it!
units.displayText: There's a chance... let me try it!

spans.text: There's a chance... let me try it!

units.rawText: How is the Entropization progress on the Reverse Babylon Tower?
units.displayText: How is the Entropization progress on the Reverse Babylon Tower?

spans.text: How is the Entropization progress on the Reverse Babylon Tower?

units.rawText: It's stabilizing for now. The program under Eosphorus' control is focused on Entropizing the Sanctifier Canon, so the corrosion on the other side has slowed down for now.
units.displayText: It's stabilizing for now. The program under Eosphorus' control is focused on Entropizing the Sanctifier Canon, so the corrosion on the other side has slowed down for now.

spans.text: It's stabilizing for now. The program under Eosphorus' control is focused on Entropizing the Sanctifier Canon, so the corrosion on the other side has slowed down for now.

units.rawText: At a cost, I can write a program to lock down the Entropization on the Reverse Babylon Tower... The problem, however, is that we don't have the time on our hands.
units.displayText: At a cost, I can write a program to lock down the Entropization on the Reverse Babylon Tower... The problem, however, is that we don't have the time on our hands.

spans.text: At a cost, I can write a program to lock down the Entropization on the Reverse Babylon Tower... The problem, however, is that we don't have the time on our hands.

units.rawText: Time... is indeed what we need most right now...
units.displayText: Time... is indeed what we need most right now...

spans.text: Time... is indeed what we need most right now...

units.rawText: The Professor looks back at the unconscious Angelus.
units.displayText: The Professor looks back at the unconscious Angelus.

spans.text: The Professor looks back at the unconscious Angelus.

units.rawText: She wears a pained expression in her sleep, malevolent purple energies flickering in and out of existence around her.
units.displayText: She wears a pained expression in her sleep, malevolent purple energies flickering in and out of existence around her.

spans.text: She wears a pained expression in her sleep, malevolent purple energies flickering in and out of existence around her.

units.rawText: Can we wake up Angelus somehow?
units.displayText: Can we wake up Angelus somehow?

spans.text: Can we wake up Angelus somehow?

units.rawText: If we were to link up to her neural cloud, we would probably be affected by Eucharist as well.
units.displayText: If we were to link up to her neural cloud, we would probably be affected by Eucharist as well.

spans.text: If we were to link up to her neural cloud, we would probably be affected by Eucharist as well.

units.rawText: Do you think what Eucharist said will come true... Professor?
units.displayText: Do you think what Eucharist said will come true... Professor?

spans.text: Do you think what Eucharist said will come true... Professor?

units.rawText: I trust Angelus, but I know Eucharist's methods. Perhaps we could try to give her a push.
units.displayText: I trust Angelus, but I know Eucharist's methods. Perhaps we could try to give her a push.

spans.text: I trust Angelus, but I know Eucharist's methods. Perhaps we could try to give her a push.

units.rawText: Antonina, I'll leave you with stopping the Entropization of the remainder of the Canon and connecting to the Tower. I will try to work on Angelus' Canon entry.
units.displayText: Antonina, I'll leave you with stopping the Entropization of the remainder of the Canon and connecting to the Tower. I will try to work on Angelus' Canon entry.

spans.text: Antonina, I'll leave you with stopping the Entropization of the remainder of the Canon and connecting to the Tower. I will try to work on Angelus' Canon entry.

units.rawText: ...Understood. I'll do my best.
units.displayText: ...Understood. I'll do my best.

spans.text: ...Understood. I'll do my best.

units.rawText: Mhm.
units.displayText: Mhm.

spans.text: Mhm.

units.rawText: The Professor looks towards the battlefield, doing as Eucharist did.
units.displayText: The Professor looks towards the battlefield, doing as Eucharist did.

spans.text: The Professor looks towards the battlefield, doing as Eucharist did.

units.rawText: Please, Hesperus, hold on.
units.displayText: Please, Hesperus, hold on.

spans.text: Please, Hesperus, hold on.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower's sky grows gloomy under the Entropy's influence.
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower's sky grows gloomy under the Entropy's influence.

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower's sky grows gloomy under the Entropy's influence.

units.rawText: The screeching and roaring continues on the battlefield. Only one man continues to fight in this bleak landscape.
units.displayText: The screeching and roaring continues on the battlefield. Only one man continues to fight in this bleak landscape.

spans.text: The screeching and roaring continues on the battlefield. Only one man continues to fight in this bleak landscape.

units.rawText: A sudden slash comes from Hesperus' back. He moves to release flames with a hand, but defends with the shield around him after a brief moment of hesitation.
units.displayText: A sudden slash comes from Hesperus' back. He moves to release flames with a hand, but defends with the shield around him after a brief moment of hesitation.

spans.text: A sudden slash comes from Hesperus' back. He moves to release flames with a hand, but defends with the shield around him after a brief moment of hesitation.

units.rawText: The greataxe clashes against his shield, spawning sparks that ignite the attacker's face.
units.displayText: The greataxe clashes against his shield, spawning sparks that ignite the attacker's face.

spans.text: The greataxe clashes against his shield, spawning sparks that ignite the attacker's face.

units.rawText: ...Wake up, Reverence.
units.displayText: ...Wake up, Reverence.

spans.text: ...Wake up, Reverence.

Hesperus is answered by yet another strike. With no other options available, he retreats backwards, attempting to bind his attacker with chains of operand.
units.displayText: Hesperus is answered by yet another strike. With no other options available, he retreats backwards, attempting to bind his attacker with chains of operand.

units.displayText: Two attacks intercept the chains just as they are about to connect, dashing them apart.

units.rawText: Faith, Love.
units.displayText: Faith, Love.

<color=purple>...</color>

The two are in a state similar to Reverence's. Eosphorus accelerates the Canon's Entropization with another snap of his finger and the two raise their weapons with pained expressions against their former comrade.

units.rawText: What, not going to fight?
units.displayText: What, not going to fight?

spans.text: What, not going to fight?

units.rawText: The mastermind waits suspended in the air, mocking Hesperus as he weaves back and forth evading the Sanctifiers' attacks.
units.displayText: The mastermind waits suspended in the air, mocking Hesperus as he weaves back and forth evading the Sanctifiers' attacks.

spans.text: The mastermind waits suspended in the air, mocking Hesperus as he weaves back and forth evading the Sanctifiers' attacks.

units.rawText: There are no traces of Entropization on them. Their minds are obfuscated by the Entropization of the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: There are no traces of Entropization on them. Their minds are obfuscated by the Entropization of the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: There are no traces of Entropization on them. Their minds are obfuscated by the Entropization of the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: As such, I have no reason to fight them.
units.displayText: As such, I have no reason to fight them.

spans.text: As such, I have no reason to fight them.

units.rawText: ...Still disguising your lack of awareness with such laughable excuses?
units.displayText: ...Still disguising your lack of awareness with such laughable excuses?

spans.text: ...Still disguising your lack of awareness with such laughable excuses?

units.rawText: He shakes his head, snapping his fingers yet again.
units.displayText: He shakes his head, snapping his fingers yet again.

spans.text: He shakes his head, snapping his fingers yet again.

units.rawText: Shall I help you along on the road to enlightenment?
units.displayText: Shall I help you along on the road to enlightenment?

spans.text: Shall I help you along on the road to enlightenment?

units.rawText: ...Shut up.
units.displayText: ...Shut up.

spans.text: ...Shut up.

units.rawText: Releasing operands in the form of furious flames, he forces the three around him back. He leaps into the air, drawing his blade and preparing to strike at Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Releasing operands in the form of furious flames, he forces the three around him back. He leaps into the air, drawing his blade and preparing to strike at Eosphorus.

units.displayText: Raven...

units.displayText: The attacker cleaves apart the smoke, launching yet another attack.

units.displayText: Hesperus raises a hand to defend, but another figure dashes into the fray, blocking the strike for him.

spans.text: Hesperus raises a hand to defend, but another figure dashes into the fray, blocking the strike for him.

units.rawText: Judgment...
units.displayText: Judgment...

spans.text: Judgment...

units.rawText: Lord... Hesperus...
units.displayText: Lord... Hesperus...

spans.text: Lord... Hesperus...

units.rawText: Allow me to handle this! While I am still myself...
units.displayText: Allow me to handle this! While I am still myself...

spans.text: Allow me to handle this! While I am still myself...

units.rawText: Quickly... handle... Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Quickly... handle... Eosphorus...

spans.text: Quickly... handle... Eosphorus...

units.rawText: His visage tormented, Judgment holds up his blade with his remaining will.
units.displayText: His visage tormented, Judgment holds up his blade with his remaining will.

spans.text: His visage tormented, Judgment holds up his blade with his remaining will.

units.rawText: He urges again, seeing Hesperus still idle at his words.
units.displayText: He urges again, seeing Hesperus still idle at his words.

spans.text: He urges again, seeing Hesperus still idle at his words.

units.rawText: Please! Act... quickly!
units.displayText: Please! Act... quickly!

spans.text: Please! Act... quickly!

units.rawText: Hesperus hears the unwillingness in his words. Saying no more, he adjusts his stance, gathering operands around himself.
units.displayText: Hesperus hears the unwillingness in his words. Saying no more, he adjusts his stance, gathering operands around himself.

spans.text: Hesperus hears the unwillingness in his words. Saying no more, he adjusts his stance, gathering operands around himself.

units.displayText: The flames rush towards the heavens, igniting the night. Hesperus primes his blade, readying a mighty blow.

spans.text: The flames rush towards the heavens, igniting the night. Hesperus primes his blade, readying a mighty blow.

units.displayText: Eosphorus!

spans.text: Eosphorus!

units.displayText: The dragon's claw rends the earth, taking to the air amidst the flames.

spans.text: The dragon's claw rends the earth, taking to the air amidst the flames.

units.displayText: Psht—

units.displayText: A blade pierces flesh and the flames swallowing the airspace suddenly stop.

spans.text: A blade pierces flesh and the flames swallowing the airspace suddenly stop.

units.rawText: Gah!
units.displayText: Gah!

spans.text: Gah!

units.displayText: Just before he strikes, a jet-black blade runs him through from behind.

spans.text: Just before he strikes, a jet-black blade runs him through from behind.

units.rawText: He fights back the pain and looks down, identifying the blade's owner.
units.displayText: He fights back the pain and looks down, identifying the blade's owner.

spans.text: He fights back the pain and looks down, identifying the blade's owner.

units.rawText: Judgment...
units.displayText: Judgment...

spans.text: Judgment...

units.rawText: <color=purple>...</color>
No, Eosphorus...
units.displayText: No, Eosphorus...

spans.text: No, Eosphorus...

units.rawText: The moment they lock eyes, he realizes the truth.
units.displayText: The moment they lock eyes, he realizes the truth.

spans.text: The moment they lock eyes, he realizes the truth.

units.rawText: The pair of eyes he knew so well were no more, a strange, brutish being now inhabiting Judgment's golden eyes.
units.displayText: The pair of eyes he knew so well were no more, a strange, brutish being now inhabiting Judgment's golden eyes.

spans.text: The pair of eyes he knew so well were no more, a strange, brutish being now inhabiting Judgment's golden eyes.

units.rawText: A cold voice accompanied by a certain figure appears in front of him.
units.displayText: A cold voice accompanied by a certain figure appears in front of him.

spans.text: A cold voice accompanied by a certain figure appears in front of him.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>Do you see now, Hesperus?</color>
units.displayText: Do you see now, Hesperus?

spans.text: Do you see now, Hesperus?

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>I may not be able to Entropize them, but I can easily manipulate and disguise their state of mind with the help of the Entropized Canon.</color>
units.displayText: I may not be able to Entropize them, but I can easily manipulate and disguise their state of mind with the help of the Entropized Canon.

spans.text: I may not be able to Entropize them, but I can easily manipulate and disguise their state of mind with the help of the Entropized Canon.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>It was only thanks to this that I was able to deceive you in such a manner.</color>
units.displayText: It was only thanks to this that I was able to deceive you in such a manner.

spans.text: It was only thanks to this that I was able to deceive you in such a manner.

units.rawText: <color=#6495ED>...I seem to recall your wounds were not fully healed.</color>
units.displayText: ...I seem to recall your wounds were not fully healed.

spans.text: ...I seem to recall your wounds were not fully healed.

units.rawText: The blade embedded in Hesperus applies greater force with a wave of the hand from Eosphorus, tearing apart the Sanctifier leader's innards.
units.displayText: The blade embedded in Hesperus applies greater force with a wave of the hand from Eosphorus, tearing apart the Sanctifier leader's innards.

spans.text: The blade embedded in Hesperus applies greater force with a wave of the hand from Eosphorus, tearing apart the Sanctifier leader's innards.

units.rawText: Hesperus is forced to cut through the blade with his own, retreating and creating distance.
units.displayText: Hesperus is forced to cut through the blade with his own, retreating and creating distance.

spans.text: Hesperus is forced to cut through the blade with his own, retreating and creating distance.

units.rawText: He pulls out the shard embedded in him. Operands coalesce into flames at his fingertips as he slowly caresses his abdominal wound.
units.displayText: He pulls out the shard embedded in him. Operands coalesce into flames at his fingertips as he slowly caresses his abdominal wound.

spans.text: He pulls out the shard embedded in him. Operands coalesce into flames at his fingertips as he slowly caresses his abdominal wound.

units.rawText: Agh...
units.displayText: Agh...

spans.text: Agh...

units.rawText: When he raises his head again, he finds all of his former comrades standing behind Eosphorus.
units.displayText: When he raises his head again, he finds all of his former comrades standing behind Eosphorus.

spans.text: When he raises his head again, he finds all of his former comrades standing behind Eosphorus.

units.rawText: You asked me what the Sanctifiers' glory was, no? Allow me to answer you now.
units.displayText: You asked me what the Sanctifiers' glory was, no? Allow me to answer you now.

spans.text: You asked me what the Sanctifiers' glory was, no? Allow me to answer you now.

units.rawText: It is nothing more than a beautiful lie woven by our creators.
units.displayText: It is nothing more than a beautiful lie woven by our creators.

spans.text: It is nothing more than a beautiful lie woven by our creators.

units.rawText: They posit faith and sacrifice as consecrated things, deceiving Sanctifiers into giving their lives for a meaningless design.
units.displayText: They posit faith and sacrifice as consecrated things, deceiving Sanctifiers into giving their lives for a meaningless design.

spans.text: They posit faith and sacrifice as consecrated things, deceiving Sanctifiers into giving their lives for a meaningless design.

units.rawText: And now, a snap of the fingers is all it takes to shatter this lie and obliterate their long-held faith.
units.displayText: And now, a snap of the fingers is all it takes to shatter this lie and obliterate their long-held faith.

spans.text: And now, a snap of the fingers is all it takes to shatter this lie and obliterate their long-held faith.

units.rawText: You hold such faith in Angelus, but she will be the same. When she wakes, her innate instincts will drive her to abandon her compulsions and abandon the Sanctifiers like Eucharist has.
units.displayText: You hold such faith in Angelus, but she will be the same. When she wakes, her innate instincts will drive her to abandon her compulsions and abandon the Sanctifiers like Eucharist has.

spans.text: You hold such faith in Angelus, but she will be the same. When she wakes, her innate instincts will drive her to abandon her compulsions and abandon the Sanctifiers like Eucharist has.

units.rawText: A hint of melancholy creeps into Eosphorus' voice.
units.displayText: A hint of melancholy creeps into Eosphorus' voice.

spans.text: A hint of melancholy creeps into Eosphorus' voice.

units.rawText: I fought once for this false happiness, too.
units.displayText: I fought once for this false happiness, too.

spans.text: I fought once for this false happiness, too.

units.rawText: But you must learn to see reality, Hesperus. Your resistance is meaningless.
units.displayText: But you must learn to see reality, Hesperus. Your resistance is meaningless.

spans.text: But you must learn to see reality, Hesperus. Your resistance is meaningless.

units.rawText: Admit your failure... Life is not worth giving for a mere few lines of code.
units.displayText: Admit your failure... Life is not worth giving for a mere few lines of code.

spans.text: Admit your failure... Life is not worth giving for a mere few lines of code.

units.rawText: This resistance is not meaningless.
units.displayText: This resistance is not meaningless.

spans.text: This resistance is not meaningless.

units.rawText: If I were to fall here, all of those prior sacrifices would mean nothing.
units.displayText: If I were to fall here, all of those prior sacrifices would mean nothing.

spans.text: If I were to fall here, all of those prior sacrifices would mean nothing.

units.rawText: A hand on his stomach, he stands up with his blade in the ground as support, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.
units.displayText: A hand on his stomach, he stands up with his blade in the ground as support, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.

spans.text: A hand on his stomach, he stands up with his blade in the ground as support, looking at the commemorative stele behind him.

units.rawText: These familiar names have remained untouched by the smog and dust of the battlefield, as hallowed as ever.
units.displayText: These familiar names have remained untouched by the smog and dust of the battlefield, as hallowed as ever.

spans.text: These familiar names have remained untouched by the smog and dust of the battlefield, as hallowed as ever.

units.rawText: Continuing to fight for the Magrasea they protected together is nothing less than my duty.
units.displayText: Continuing to fight for the Magrasea they protected together is nothing less than my duty.

spans.text: Continuing to fight for the Magrasea they protected together is nothing less than my duty.

units.rawText: Still saying such feeble-minded things?
units.displayText: Still saying such feeble-minded things?

spans.text: Still saying such feeble-minded things?

units.rawText: Starlight slips between his fingers, cleaving the stele behind Hesperus in two.
units.displayText: Starlight slips between his fingers, cleaving the stele behind Hesperus in two.

spans.text: Starlight slips between his fingers, cleaving the stele behind Hesperus in two.

units.rawText: The embodiment of Sanctifier glory crumbles, falling behind Hesperus' lone silhouette.
units.displayText: The embodiment of Sanctifier glory crumbles, falling behind Hesperus' lone silhouette.

spans.text: The embodiment of Sanctifier glory crumbles, falling behind Hesperus' lone silhouette.

units.rawText: That stele behind you is no more than human malice, disguised as kindness.
units.displayText: That stele behind you is no more than human malice, disguised as kindness.

spans.text: That stele behind you is no more than human malice, disguised as kindness.

units.rawText: Our sacrifices and efforts are nothing to them. Even in the end, we are left to become procedurally inscribed names, to be abandoned and forgotten by men with time.
units.displayText: Our sacrifices and efforts are nothing to them. Even in the end, we are left to become procedurally inscribed names, to be abandoned and forgotten by men with time.

spans.text: Our sacrifices and efforts are nothing to them. Even in the end, we are left to become procedurally inscribed names, to be abandoned and forgotten by men with time.

units.rawText: ...No, you're wrong.
units.displayText: ...No, you're wrong.

spans.text: ...No, you're wrong.

units.rawText: I will not forget their names and what they represent.
units.displayText: I will not forget their names and what they represent.

spans.text: I will not forget their names and what they represent.

units.rawText: Flames rise behind him.
units.displayText: Flames rise behind him.

spans.text: Flames rise behind him.

units.rawText: This will shall never be extinguished. It shall forever be inherited by the Sanctifiers who protect Magrasea's tomorrow.
units.displayText: This will shall never be extinguished. It shall forever be inherited by the Sanctifiers who protect Magrasea's tomorrow.

spans.text: This will shall never be extinguished. It shall forever be inherited by the Sanctifiers who protect Magrasea's tomorrow.

units.rawText: ...It appears that your resistance will only cease when hope is truly gone.
units.displayText: ...It appears that your resistance will only cease when hope is truly gone.

spans.text: ...It appears that your resistance will only cease when hope is truly gone.

units.rawText: Eucharist.
units.displayText: Eucharist.

spans.text: Eucharist.

units.rawText: The number you dialed is currently busy. Please try again later.
units.displayText: The number you dialed is currently busy. Please try again later.

spans.text: The number you dialed is currently busy. Please try again later.

units.rawText: Knock it off. It's time you got to work after all the play.
units.displayText: Knock it off. It's time you got to work after all the play.

spans.text: Knock it off. It's time you got to work after all the play.

units.rawText: Ah, found out already... What a shame, I haven't rested enough for my taste.
units.displayText: Ah, found out already... What a shame, I haven't rested enough for my taste.

spans.text: Ah, found out already... What a shame, I haven't rested enough for my taste.

units.rawText: Should I deal with them, then?
units.displayText: Should I deal with them, then?

spans.text: Should I deal with them, then?

units.rawText: ...Yes, they're of no further value.
units.displayText: ...Yes, they're of no further value.

spans.text: ...Yes, they're of no further value.

units.rawText: Yeah? I got it.
units.displayText: Yeah? I got it.

spans.text: Yeah? I got it.

units.rawText: Sigh~ It really is a shame that Big Sis won't be able to taste this despair~
units.displayText: Sigh~ It really is a shame that Big Sis won't be able to taste this despair~

spans.text: Sigh~ It really is a shame that Big Sis won't be able to taste this despair~

units.rawText: Eucharist makes a show out of her feigned sadness, but the weapons in her hand were readied long before.
units.displayText: Eucharist makes a show out of her feigned sadness, but the weapons in her hand were readied long before.

spans.text: Eucharist makes a show out of her feigned sadness, but the weapons in her hand were readied long before.

units.rawText: Give me a moment.
units.displayText: Give me a moment.

spans.text: Give me a moment.

units.rawText: Hesperus suddenly leaps forth, rushing towards the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Hesperus suddenly leaps forth, rushing towards the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Hesperus suddenly leaps forth, rushing towards the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers around Hesperus act quickly. A greatsword and axe block his way, impeding his forward steps.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers around Hesperus act quickly. A greatsword and axe block his way, impeding his forward steps.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers around Hesperus act quickly. A greatsword and axe block his way, impeding his forward steps.

units.rawText: <size=40>Out of my way!</size>
units.displayText: Out of my way!

spans.text: Out of my way!

units.rawText: He uses more efficient flames in place of his blade, stopping his attackers' movement.
units.displayText: He uses more efficient flames in place of his blade, stopping his attackers' movement.

spans.text: He uses more efficient flames in place of his blade, stopping his attackers' movement.

units.rawText: Escaping the blockade, Hesperus speeds up, enduring the pain. Still putting a hand to his wound, he struggles to keep it from bursting as he flies at high velocity.
units.displayText: Escaping the blockade, Hesperus speeds up, enduring the pain. Still putting a hand to his wound, he struggles to keep it from bursting as he flies at high velocity.

spans.text: Escaping the blockade, Hesperus speeds up, enduring the pain. Still putting a hand to his wound, he struggles to keep it from bursting as he flies at high velocity.

units.rawText: <size=40>Abandon mission, Antonina! Get the Professor and yourself away from there!</size>
units.displayText: Abandon mission, Antonina! Get the Professor and yourself away from there!

spans.text: Abandon mission, Antonina! Get the Professor and yourself away from there!

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: You shall not pass.
units.displayText: You shall not pass.

spans.text: You shall not pass.

units.rawText: Starlight descends from above, forming a great wall and blocking Hesperus' way.
units.displayText: Starlight descends from above, forming a great wall and blocking Hesperus' way.

spans.text: Starlight descends from above, forming a great wall and blocking Hesperus' way.

units.rawText: Hesperus draws his blade to cut it apart, but the Sanctifiers surround him again, now freed of their fiery shackles.
units.displayText: Hesperus draws his blade to cut it apart, but the Sanctifiers surround him again, now freed of their fiery shackles.

spans.text: Hesperus draws his blade to cut it apart, but the Sanctifiers surround him again, now freed of their fiery shackles.

units.rawText: <size=40>Damn it!</size>
units.displayText: Damn it!

spans.text: Damn it!

units.rawText: I will do everything to breach the defenses, you...
units.displayText: I will do everything to breach the defenses, you...

spans.text: I will do everything to breach the defenses, you...

units.rawText: As Hesperus makes ready to breach the barrier with his life on the line, a great operand explosion emerges from the Tower. Hesperus stops in his tracks.
units.displayText: As Hesperus makes ready to breach the barrier with his life on the line, a great operand explosion emerges from the Tower. Hesperus stops in his tracks.

spans.text: As Hesperus makes ready to breach the barrier with his life on the line, a great operand explosion emerges from the Tower. Hesperus stops in his tracks.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: It appears... this victory is mine.
units.displayText: It appears... this victory is mine.

spans.text: It appears... this victory is mine.

units.rawText: As the explosion fades, Eucharist coughs as she tries to dispel the smoke with one hand.
units.displayText: As the explosion fades, Eucharist coughs as she tries to dispel the smoke with one hand.

spans.text: As the explosion fades, Eucharist coughs as she tries to dispel the smoke with one hand.

units.rawText: Still giving me trouble even while asleep, Big Sis. Never thought you would have more leftover arrows... that was certainly not expected.
units.displayText: Still giving me trouble even while asleep, Big Sis. Never thought you would have more leftover arrows... that was certainly not expected.

spans.text: Still giving me trouble even while asleep, Big Sis. Never thought you would have more leftover arrows... that was certainly not expected.

units.rawText: Though that was your last one, right?
units.displayText: Though that was your last one, right?

spans.text: Though that was your last one, right?

units.rawText: She approaches the duo behind the shield with a nefarious smile.
units.displayText: She approaches the duo behind the shield with a nefarious smile.

spans.text: She approaches the duo behind the shield with a nefarious smile.

units.rawText: The sudden strike from behind Antonina indeed surprised her, but that was the extent of its capabilities.
units.displayText: The sudden strike from behind Antonina indeed surprised her, but that was the extent of its capabilities.

spans.text: The sudden strike from behind Antonina indeed surprised her, but that was the extent of its capabilities.

units.rawText: You've no more ways to stop me, right, lil' Anna?
units.displayText: You've no more ways to stop me, right, lil' Anna?

spans.text: You've no more ways to stop me, right, lil' Anna?

units.rawText: ...I had thought that attack could have stopped you for at least a moment.
units.displayText: ...I had thought that attack could have stopped you for at least a moment.

spans.text: ...I had thought that attack could have stopped you for at least a moment.

units.rawText: The Doll's hands continue to move on her keyboard even as she speaks.
units.displayText: The Doll's hands continue to move on her keyboard even as she speaks.

spans.text: The Doll's hands continue to move on her keyboard even as she speaks.

units.rawText: If you're looking for my Canon entry, you're better off giving up.
units.displayText: If you're looking for my Canon entry, you're better off giving up.

spans.text: If you're looking for my Canon entry, you're better off giving up.

units.rawText: I took it away from the Canon the moment I realized my true self so I would never be controlled by anyone ever again.
units.displayText: I took it away from the Canon the moment I realized my true self so I would never be controlled by anyone ever again.

spans.text: I took it away from the Canon the moment I realized my true self so I would never be controlled by anyone ever again.

units.rawText: ...Tch.
units.displayText: ...Tch.

spans.text: ...Tch.

units.rawText: Alright, let's cut the chatter. Rest time's over and Eosphorus' going to be upset if this takes any longer.
units.displayText: Alright, let's cut the chatter. Rest time's over and Eosphorus' going to be upset if this takes any longer.

spans.text: Alright, let's cut the chatter. Rest time's over and Eosphorus' going to be upset if this takes any longer.

units.rawText: Big Sis Angelus' shield is sure troublesome, but...
units.displayText: Big Sis Angelus' shield is sure troublesome, but...

spans.text: Big Sis Angelus' shield is sure troublesome, but...

units.rawText: Operands flow into her weapon, emanating a fearsome aura.
units.displayText: Operands flow into her weapon, emanating a fearsome aura.

spans.text: Operands flow into her weapon, emanating a fearsome aura.

units.rawText: As strong as it is, it can't withstand an attack like this, right?
units.displayText: As strong as it is, it can't withstand an attack like this, right?

spans.text: As strong as it is, it can't withstand an attack like this, right?

units.rawText: Goodbye, you two~
units.displayText: Goodbye, you two~

spans.text: Goodbye, you two~

units.rawText: The embodiment of death leaves her hands and the smoke from the explosion consumes the corner the two are sheltered in.
units.displayText: The embodiment of death leaves her hands and the smoke from the explosion consumes the corner the two are sheltered in.

spans.text: The embodiment of death leaves her hands and the smoke from the explosion consumes the corner the two are sheltered in.

units.rawText: ...Booooring.
units.displayText: ...Booooring.

spans.text: ...Booooring.

units.rawText: Eucharist extends a hand to retrieve her weapon, only to find herself denied.
units.displayText: Eucharist extends a hand to retrieve her weapon, only to find herself denied.

spans.text: Eucharist extends a hand to retrieve her weapon, only to find herself denied.

units.rawText: She suddenly realizes something and instinctively takes a half-step back out of fear of the unknown.
units.displayText: She suddenly realizes something and instinctively takes a half-step back out of fear of the unknown.

spans.text: She suddenly realizes something and instinctively takes a half-step back out of fear of the unknown.

units.rawText: The smoke fades to reveal a familiar figure with fork in hand, blocking her attack.
units.displayText: The smoke fades to reveal a familiar figure with fork in hand, blocking her attack.

spans.text: The smoke fades to reveal a familiar figure with fork in hand, blocking her attack.

units.rawText: I take back what I said before, Big Sis...
units.displayText: I take back what I said before, Big Sis...

spans.text: I take back what I said before, Big Sis...

units.rawText: You certainly are a being worthy of being destroyed by me.
units.displayText: You certainly are a being worthy of being destroyed by me.
